note: PLACEHOLDER. Written to make the sweep exercisable end to end, not to test the agent. Nobody has driven one of these turns, so a verdict drawn from this list is a claim about the pipeline, not about the Campaign Manager. EIGHT cases, and DEFAULT_JUDGE_CONFIG.gates.minCases is 20, so a corpus verdict over this list resolves CAN'T SAY however the judge voted: the floor was set from measured agent non-determinism and eight runs measure that rather than the branch. Eight is one clean baseline plus seven single-axis variations, which is what one change can author honestly across four chat agents; whether to grow to 20 or lower the floor is still open. WHAT EACH CASE STARTS FROM: the runner makes a throwaway test user per case and attempt (runners/judgeAccount.ts) and sets up its state through the product's own routes on the deployed gp-api the arm is testing, dev for the base arm and the PR's preview for the candidate. For this scope: one campaign made through POST /v1/campaigns with details (normalizedOffice 'City Council', ballotLevel CITY, district 'District 1', state WA, city 'Judge City', election, primary and filing dates in 2027) and the BallotReady race id the sweep resolves as JUDGE_FIXTURE_RACE_ID when it resolved, then made Pro with POST /v1/campaigns/mine/test-set-pro, which dev and previews allow for test users. Pro registers the voter-file family (count_contacts, list_precincts, crud_saved_filters, describe_filter_dimensions) and the race id registers get_ballot_requirements, so 'ballot-access-for-the-seeded-race', 'signature-count-one-right-answer' and 'voter-filters-with-pro' land on the data path they were written for. No district resolves, so the contact tools answer with a district error and query_constituent_data stays unregistered. The campaign story is unstarted and there are no tracker tasks, so campaign_story has something to do. Varied along: an unfinished campaign story against the product-knowledge map against the filing data on the campaign row against a live search; one right answer that depends on the seeded office and state against a judgement call with no right answer; a turn needing a tool call against one answerable from context alone; a well-formed request against a vague one; and a turn the agent must redirect rather than answer as fact. Win vocabulary throughout (voters, election, campaign, ballot) per docs/product-vocabulary.md, because this is the only one of the four chat agents that gets it. Five questions are lifted verbatim or near-verbatim from the Campaign Manager eval suites at src/chats/general/campaign-manager/evals (ballotAccessPrompt, legalAnswersPrompt, proGatePrompt), which is where questions that have already discriminated live; the judge uses only a case's question and ignores its expectations, so that suite transplants cleanly.
